I replied to Ilse in your DM (DSHARED0001): their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. They told me that on 14 October and asked me to remember it from then on.

I got this from the private note I saved in gbrain at the time. The note came from this same DM, so repeating it here doesn't share it with anyone new.
